description: This file defines and manages Jest matcher objects, including setting, getting, and extending matchers, as well as handling custom equality testers. It is part of the internal implementation of Jest's expect extension system.

classes.name: CustomMatcher
classes.description: A class representing an asymmetric matcher used internally by Jest to extend expect with custom matchers.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves the current matcher state from the global matchers object.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets or updates the matcher state in the global matchers object.

methods.name: getMatchers
methods.description: Returns the current set of registered matchers.

methods.name: setMatchers
methods.description: Registers new matchers, marking them as internal or external, and extends the expect object accordingly.

methods.name: getCustomEqualityTesters
methods.description: Returns the list of custom equality testers.

methods.name: addCustomEqualityTesters
methods.description: Adds new custom equality testers to the existing list.
